name: green-zone-series-offset-na
note: An `na` series offset falls back to 0, anchoring the object on its own spawn bar. Unlike an `na` PRICE -- which drops a marker, because there is no defensible level to draw it at -- an `na` offset has an obvious identity: no shift. Dropping the object instead would make a zone vanish whenever its offset expression was still warming up, which is the one moment a warmup-sensitive port most needs to see it. Here `ta.sma(close, 10)` is na at bar 3 on a 5-bar dataset, so x1 must equal the spawn bar 3.
source:
indicator("H", shorttitle="H", overlay=true)
sm = ta.sma(close, 10)
plotzone(bar_index == 3, high, low, "Z", offset=-sm, extend=extend.bars, bars=1)
